title: Check register row
description: One paper check turned into data. A check prints its amount twice, in figures (the courtesy amount) and in words (the legal amount); both are kept so they can be compared. The MICR line along the bottom repeats the routing number, account number and check number in magnetic ink; it is kept as printed and also split into fields.

check_number.description: Number printed in the top right corner.

date.description: Date written on the check, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

payee.description: Pay to the order of. Blank only on a void check.

amount.description: Courtesy amount in figures, positive, two decimals. Blank on a void check.

amount_written.description: Legal amount in words exactly as written, e.g. 'One thousand two hundred fifty and 00/100'. 'VOID' on a void check.

memo.description: Memo line. Often an invoice or account number.

bank.description: Drawee bank name printed on the check.

routing_number.description: ABA routing transit number from the MICR line. Passes the 3-7-1 checksum.

account_last4.description: Last four digits of the account number. Store no more than this outside the MICR line.

micr_line.description: MICR line as printed, with U+2448 (on-us) and U+2446 (transit) symbols: '⑈001043⑈ ⑆512345674⑆ 0004471229⑈'.

cleared_date.description: Date the check cleared the bank, from the bank statement. Blank unless status is cleared.
